title: OpenNR-GEN final findings: the deployable raw-input path is not ready

rows.finding: Visible material, lighting, and texture changes; the long prompt was truncated by the SDXL CLIP limit.
All four eyes were visually rejected; the follow-up remained structurally unsafe despite lower strength.
Coherent and stereo-consistent, but retention-only: not visibly preferable to the teacher.
Coherent pair, but no independent realism gain; edge/high-frequency proxies were lower than the teacher.
The pleasing full-face result was generated from the teacher. It demonstrates an offline look, not a deployable student target.
Stopped after 12 eyes when the input-role error was corrected; preserved as provenance evidence and excluded from training.
Manifest sample paths pointed at the wrong root; superseded by the corrected v2 route.
Correct deployable graph, but conservative/near raw and worse on teacher MAE than the vanilla input.
Maximum tested strength produced psychedelic texture and facial distortion; not usable.
Changed shield pattern, suppressed fire, and altered stone/material response; no stable prettier replacement.
Preserved research probe; no accepted review or complete tranche, and it remains teacher-conditioned.
Repeating cyan/black grid artifact; not a scene-preserving target.
The same grid artifact persisted in a second compatibility stack; license also bars competitive-model distillation.
Dry-run only; verifies the raw-input branch without consuming GPU time or creating targets.

evidenceFlow.title: Route inventory

evidenceFlow.title: Visual review
evidenceFlow.detail: Reviewed the preserved three-way and full-face galleries; route decisions distinguish structural fidelity, teacher preference, and input provenance.

metricDefinitions.label: Input role
metricDefinitions.definition: The image given to the offline enhancer. raw_input is the deployable vanilla input; dlss5_teacher is an offline reference and is not available to the in-game student.

metricDefinitions.label: Student eligibility
metricDefinitions.definition: False unless a complete 40-eye route passes hashes, pair completeness, visual review, and teacher-preference checks.

caveats: A generated image and a passing hash audit do not establish realism, geometry safety, temporal quality, stereo quality, or runtime viability.
Some probes have only one eye or two eyes and therefore cannot establish a complete stereo/static tranche.

source.label: Matched full-face scene-019-eye0 probes
filters: Same scene-019-eye0 raw input and DLSS5 teacher reference
Scores are image-space proxies, not a realism metric

evidenceFlow.title: Score calculation
evidenceFlow.detail: Read the route scores.json files produced by score_static_targets.py; raw_teacher_mae is the fixed vanilla-to-teacher baseline for this face, while target_teacher_mae compares each generated target to the teacher.

evidenceFlow.title: Gallery order
evidenceFlow.detail: Each full_face_ordered_gallery.png is ordered vanilla input, SDXL output, DLSS5 teacher.

metricDefinitions.label: MAE
metricDefinitions.definition: Mean absolute pixel error in normalized RGB image space; lower means closer in pixels, not necessarily more realistic or preferable.

metricDefinitions.label: Target clip fraction
metricDefinitions.definition: Fraction of output pixel channels at the normalized image bounds; it is a warning signal for clipping, not a quality score.

caveats: The teacher-conditioned face result cannot be used to claim raw-input enhancement because the enhancer saw the teacher image.
The face probe is one eye; it does not prove stereo consistency or a complete static target tranche.
